title.zh: 第1234号法：授权Samar省议会为在抵御Pulajanes袭击、保卫该省市镇时受伤的居民志愿者，以及被Pulajanes打伤的太平洋地区居民提供照护的法案
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF THE PROVINCE OF SAMAR TO PROVIDE FOR THE CARE OF RESIDENTS WOUNDED WHILE ENGAGED AS VOLUNTEERS IN THE DEFENSE OF THE MUNICIPALITIES OF SAID PROVINCE AGAINST THE ATTACKS OF PULAJANES, AND OF PACIFIC RESIDENTS WOUNDED BY SAID PULAJANES.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF THE PROVINCE OF SAMAR TO PROVIDE FOR THE CARE OF RESIDENTS WOUNDED WHILE ENGAGED AS VOLUNTEERS IN THE DEFENSE OF THE MUNICIPALITIES OF SAID PROVINCE AGAINST THE ATTACKS OF PULAJANES, AND OF PACIFIC RESIDENTS WOUNDED BY SAID PULAJANES.
title.vi: Đạo luật số 1234: Luật cho phép tỉnh Samar chăm sóc cư dân bị thương khi tình nguyện bảo vệ các đô thị khỏi Pulajanes và cư dân Thái Bình Dương bị Pulajanes làm bị thương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่1234อนุญาตให้จังหวัดSamarดูแลผู้ได้รับบาดเจ็บขณะอาสาป้องกันเทศบาลจากPulajanesและผู้อยู่อาศัยในแปซิฟิกที่ถูกPulajanesทำร้าย
title.id: Undang-Undang Nomor 1234: yang mengizinkan Provinsi Samar merawat warga yang terluka saat menjadi sukarelawan membela kotamadya dari Pulajanes serta penduduk Pasifik yang dilukai Pulajanes
title.ms: Akta Nombor 1234: membenarkan Wilayah Samar menjaga penduduk yang cedera ketika menjadi sukarelawan mempertahankan perbandaran daripada Pulajanes serta penduduk Pasifik yang dicederakan oleh Pulajanes

text.en:
The provincial board of the Province of Samar is hereby authorized to pay out of general
provincial funds not otherwise appropriated, the necessary expenses incurred subsistence and medical
attendance at the military hospital at Camp Council, Calbayog, and at the Constabulary hospital at
Catbalogan of residents of said province wounded while engaged as volunteers in the defense of the
municipalities of said province against the attacks of pulajanes, and of pacific residents wounded by said

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 13, 1904.
